e-private-messaging.14.evidence: UI: bob Mute notifications on maya's thread -> menu 'Unmute notifications'; maya sent a message -> bob bell count unchanged and Mailpit empty (pass for the mute half). Then Unmute (menu back to 'Mute notifications') and maya sent the NEXT message -> still no bell item and no email, because the message received while muted is still unread and notify_participants only notifies the first message of an unread burst (is_first_unread). After bob opened the thread (read) the following message did notify (bell +1, one email). So the literal 'unmute and the next message notifies again' does not hold when a message arrived during the mute. Likely by design (one notification per unread burst) but the line / copy is misleading; owner call. pm-14a.png
